cohort: 265 women who gave birth by repeat caesarean section in two large public hospitals in northern Jordan between June 2005 and June 2010.
finding: Women with four or more prior caesarean sections had a significantly higher mean age, lower mean gestational age, increased need for blood transfusion, and were more likely to experience placenta praevia compared to women with three prior caesarean sections.
gest_age: Lower mean gestational age in women with four or more prior caesarean sections compared to those with three.
